Add bot to allowed_bots list or use \'*\''. Root cause: scout/coverage-critic escalate via `gh workflow run research-agent.yml -f tier=deep` using the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (scout-agent.yml sets GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}), so the triggering actor is github-actions[bot]; claude-code-action@v1 now refuses bot actors unless allowed_bots is configured, and none of the three action steps in research-agent.yml set it. Scheduled runs (verified human actor CHaerem) still succeed — confirmed: 100% of workflow_dispatch runs fail (38244621855 10-12, 38189146055 10-12, 38132855793 10-11, 38067435631 10-10, 37671789583 10-07) while every schedule run in the same window succeeds. (2) Visual QA: all scheduled runs fail since 10-07 (last success 10-06) with 'Reached maximum number of turns (40)' (run 38422490811 10-13; actor verified human). The --max-turns 40 budget is too tight for the Sonnet-5 3-width screenshot+Read+analysis+log+commit pass; some runs commit the log then overrun, others overrun first.
notes: Both fixes are protected automation paths (.github/workflows/**). The protect-automation.js PreToolUse hook BLOCKS this unattended CI agent from authoring ANY .github/workflows/** change (Edit returned exit 2: 'A human must author changes to these files'), so no branch/PR could be created — the hook is stricter than self-repair.md's 'make it anyway, it'll wait for review' clause. No non-protected alternative exists: any `gh workflow run` dispatch yields a bot actor, and max-turns is a workflow-level arg, so both fixes must live in the workflow YAML. A HUMAN must apply them.

OWNER FIX #1 (research escalations, dead since ~10-06): in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` to the `with:` block of all three `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` steps (standard Opus 4.8; deep Fable 5 preferred; deep Opus 4.8 fallback), next to claude_code_oauth_token. (`allowed_bots: "*"` is the action's catch-all alternative; "github-actions" is the minimal allow-list matching the actual dispatcher.) This re-enables scout/coverage-critic -> research escalations. Adding it does NOT affect scheduled human-actor runs.

OWNER FIX #2 (Visual QA, dead since 10-07): in .github/workflows/visual-qa-agent.yml raise `--max-turns 40` to ~80 in the claude_args of the claude-code-action step. The agent otherwise completes but the turn budget cuts it off, reporting the run as failure (which also pollutes the failed-run signal self-repair itself mines).
